title: Agent Hooks — interception record
description: Host-side record of one interception (AGENT-HOOKS-0.1 §6, §10). Payload-free: identities bind the record to the exact pre/post-fold context; session_id/sequence/decided_by provide ordering and attribution without payload duplication.

session_id.description: ctx.session.id — correlates records across a session.

sequence.description: ctx.sequence — total order of records within the session (§12.2.3).

decided_by.description: Registration index of the interceptor whose verdict became this record's verdict; null for a pure allow or a host-synthesized host_error:* verdict. A resolver-substituted verdict keeps the escalating interceptor's index.
